question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**more**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**More**" Indicates a greater quantity or degree, but it does not fit as well as "better" in expressing the idea of relevance in this context. (अधिक)

 
 
• **Example**: She asked for more time to complete the assignment.
 
 
 
• In the given passage, the word "pertinent" means relevant or important. The phrase "the more pertinent one" implies that the college dream is more relevant than the other dreams.
 
 
• **Example:** "The more relevant question is whether we can afford the project."

 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Better **(बेहतर):** **The word "better" refers to something of a higher standard, more suitable, or more relevant in comparison. 

 
 
• **Example**: She realized the better choice would be to wait for a safer opportunity.
 
 
 
• **Best** (सबसे अच्छा): Indicates the highest degree of excellence, which does not fit as the comparison in the sentence is about relevance.
 
 
• **Example:** She was awarded the best performer of the year.
 
 
 
• **Strong** (मजबूत): Refers to something powerful or having great physical strength, which does not align with the context of the sentence.
 
 
• **Example:** He has a strong grip on the subject matter.
